summary: Google DeepMind, together with Schmidt Sciences, the Cooperative AI Foundation, ARIA and Google.org, announced a technical research funding call of up to $10M for external researchers to study multi-agent AI safety.

practices.reason: The call outlines future research priority areas (sandboxes, testbeds, oversight methods) for multi-agent safety but does not itself hand engineers a concrete, reproducible evaluation instrument.
practices.quote: Sandboxes and testbeds: Building realistic, reproducible environments to evaluate, compare and accelerate progress across all areas of multi-agent safety.
